entities.name: mat awning over the stall behind the big cart
entities.what: Flat rectangular woven-mat sunshade with a grid of battens, tilted toward the viewer (front edge lower), held up over a stall north of the big covered cart; its poles are hidden by the cart, except a slanting prop pole under its front edge.
entities.vis: part: lower half and poles hidden by S5.veh.covered_ox_cart_9800
entities.note: Mat corners nw (9383, 916), ne (9601, 905), se (9576, 1037), sw (9356, 1046): about 245 x 130 px on the silk. Prop pole (9508, 1044) -> (9531, 1071). base = est ground under the middle of its front edge, taken at the stall-keepers' estimated foot line (v ~1195-1230).

entities.name: goods on the counter under the mat awning
entities.what: Wares seen over the roof of the big cart under the east half of the mat awning: a light lidded box and several round white items (rolls, loaves or bundles) set out on the stall's counter.
entities.vis: part: only the tops show above the cart roof
entities.note: Box at u 9563-9590, v 1046-1062; round items at u 9537-9595, v 1044-1090. The counter itself is hidden by the cart.

entities.name: man under the mat awning
entities.what: Man with dark hair tied up, only his head and shoulders showing above the roof of the big cart, standing under the mat awning with his face turned east toward the wares.
entities.vis: part: body hidden by S5.veh.covered_ox_cart_9800
entities.note: The figure S5's agents saw at u 9497. Foot from a standing height of ~170 px; he may sit behind the counter.

entities.name: stall man reaching for the round goods
entities.what: Man in a dark cap and light jacket under the east end of the mat awning, behind the big cart, facing the viewer with mouth open, his right arm raised and stretched east toward the stack of round goods.
entities.vis: part: body below v ~1090 hidden by S5.veh.covered_ox_cart_9800
entities.note: The figure S5's agents saw at u 9620. Arm reaches to (9683, 1040). Foot from his height.

entities.name: big dark parasol
entities.what: Big parasol with a dark cover and many radiating ribs, seen from above and tilted toward the viewer, shading the stack of round goods at the east end of the mat-awning stall; its pole is hidden.
entities.vis: part: pole hidden by the goods and the cart
entities.note: Canopy u 9600-9870, v 870-1050 (about 270 px across), apex (9715, 925). base = est ground straight below the apex, at the goods' ground line.

entities.name: stack of round goods
entities.what: About ten round, roll-like goods seen end-on, each with a dark spiral or flower-like centre (rolled mats, coiled bundles or round cakes), stacked in rows under the dark parasol between the cart's front and the man in the dark robe.
entities.vis: part: lower rows behind the cart driver
entities.note: Discs: top row v 1057-1087 at u 9687, 9720, 9757, 9787, 9820 (one more at 9710, v 1033-1053); second row v 1077-1100 at u 9800, 9820; lowest v 1103-1140 at u 9783, 9807. Each about 22-28 px across (SCALE CUE). The top row sits on a dark band (a counter or tray, v 1080-1100) just above the cart roof line, so the stack may stand on a table rather than the ground.

entities.name: big light parasol
entities.what: Big parasol with a light cover and fine radiating ribs on a tall pole, tilted toward the viewer over the small table and the big basket; the pole has a clamp or bracket part way down.
entities.vis: part: pole foot hidden behind the big basket
entities.note: Canopy u 9860-10110, v 795-900 (about 250 px across), apex (9972, 819); pole u 9962-9977 visible v 893-1010. base est at the table's foot line (v ~995).

entities.name: small table under the light parasol
entities.what: Small table or bench under the light parasol with a little frame or rack standing on it; round dark-spotted things (gourds or round wares) hang under the parasol at its west end.
entities.vis: part: legs partly hidden
entities.note: Top u 9907-9975, v 945-967 (about 68 px long); a leg foot at (9918, 993). Hanging things at u 9875-9908, v 892-915. A thin pole stands at u 9885-9893 (v 857-1000), see S4.prop.mat_awning_10030.

entities.name: big basket heaped with a brown load
entities.what: Very large round woven basket heaped high with a brown, shaggy load (straw, hemp or brushwood), the centre of a crowd of buyers east of the light parasol.
entities.vis: full
entities.note: Basket bottom u 9935-10065 at v 1100-1133, heap u 9920-10100 up to v ~975 (about 180 px wide, 155 px tall: SCALE CUE). The restyle paints a seated person in the heap; the strokes show only the heaped load.

entities.name: second mat awning
entities.what: Sloping lean-to of woven mat on battens over the stall east of the trees, its top edge high on the north side and its lower edge hidden behind the light parasol.
entities.vis: part: lower edge and poles hidden by the light parasol
entities.note: Mat u ~9860-10200, v 650-830; top edge (10013, 667) -> (10197, 677); east edge runs down-left from (10197, 677) to about (10107, 827). Supports unclear: a pole at u 9885-9893 (v 857-1000) under its west part, and slanting strokes at u 10146-10170 (v 740-890) at its east end. base = est middle of its front line.

entities.name: small slanted bench
entities.what: Small bench or stool with splayed legs under the east end of the second mat awning, beside the crouching man.
entities.vis: full

entities.name: man under the light parasol
entities.what: Man with dark hair in a light jacket standing under the west edge of the light parasol beside the thin pole, face turned east toward the basket.
entities.vis: part: lower body hidden by the round goods and the man in the dark robe
entities.note: Visible to v ~1032; foot from a standing height of ~170 px.

entities.name: man in a long dark robe
entities.what: Man in a long, dark, cowl-like robe seen from behind, standing between the stack of round goods and the big basket, facing the stalls; a child stands at his east side.
entities.vis: full
entities.note: Feet at u 9876-9908, v 1220-1237. The head is a dark rounded shape (hood, cap or hair); no face shows. The restyle paints him facing the viewer in blue; the strokes read as a back view.

entities.name: child beside the man in the dark robe
entities.what: Child with dark hair in light clothes standing at the east side of the man in the dark robe, face turned east, both hands held together in front, as if holding something small.
entities.vis: full
entities.note: Child: painted ~106 px tall against ~170 px for the men here (about 0.6 of an adult). Feet at v ~1180 (strokes end there), so the child stands a little north of the man.

entities.name: man leaning over the big basket
entities.what: Man in a dark cap and light jacket leaning far forward over the big basket from its north-east side, both arms reaching down into the heaped load, face turned down and west.
entities.vis: part: legs hidden behind the basket
entities.note: Foot est behind the basket's east part.

entities.name: bearded man bending toward the basket
entities.what: Bearded man in light clothes bending forward toward the basket, his left hand reaching out low to the goods, legs apart as if stepping west.
entities.vis: full

entities.name: man raising his arm
entities.what: Man in a dark cap and light jacket with a dark sash, standing behind the bearded man and facing the viewer, his right arm raised high to the east as if hailing someone.
entities.vis: part: lower body hidden by the bearded man
entities.note: Raised hand at (10213, 890). Foot from a standing height of ~175 px.

entities.name: crouching man under the second awning
entities.what: Man in light clothes seen from behind, hunched or squatting with a rounded back beside the small slanted bench under the east end of the second mat awning, facing north toward the donkey.
entities.vis: part: lower body hidden by the waving man's head
entities.note: Body u 10106-10163, v 766-883. He may be seated on S4.prop.bench_10180 (its top is at his east side). The restyle also paints a white-clad seated figure here.

entities.name: donkey under the second awning
entities.what: Grey donkey standing under the east end of the second mat awning, facing the viewer with its head lowered and its long ears spread sideways; no load or rider; its body runs back (north) behind the awning's edge.
entities.vis: part: body and hind legs hidden behind the mat awning
entities.note: BOUNDARY (u 10200): forelegs at (10175, 808) and (10205, 818), so fore u 10190 by measurement; t2 may also see it. Head u 10191-10218, v 759-794; ear tip (10238, 757). Body visible u 10169-10202, v 712-757. The restyle paints a man in blue here instead.

entities.name: shaft ox of the big covered cart
entities.what: Dark brown ox walking east between the shafts of S5.veh.covered_ox_cart_9800 (its shaft animal, on the near side of the team): the shafts lie along its back and rope traces run from the cart's front to its hindquarters; head low at the yoke beside the far ox's head.
entities.vis: part: middle hidden by the walking driver
entities.note: Draws S5.veh.covered_ox_cart_9800. Hind hooves: planted (9800, 1450), lifted (9840, 1410; ground ~1455). Fore hooves (9947, 1466) and (9997, 1458). Rump at u ~9776; back line v ~1310. Body ~200 px rump to chest (SCALE CUE). Its hooves stand ~40 px lower on the silk than the cart's near wheel contact (v ~1415), so the team angles slightly toward the viewer. Second pass: head moved from (9975, 1355), which sat on the collar tangle, to its own head (eye 10005-10012, 1345-1352; muzzle 10027-10038, 1355-1365), ahead of its forelegs.

entities.name: far-side ox beside the shaft ox
entities.what: Dark ox beside the shaft ox on its far (north) side, drawing S5.veh.covered_ox_cart_9800 on traces; its head, with halter and nose rope held by the leader, is lowered and turned east next to the shaft ox's head; tassels hang from its harness.
entities.vis: part: hindquarters hidden behind the shaft ox
entities.note: Draws S5.veh.covered_ox_cart_9800. Back line (9830, 1290) -> (10004, 1300); fore hooves (10030-10058, 1425-1434). Tassels at (10022, 1397) and (10081, 1395). Whether it is yoked or on traces is not drawn. Second pass: head moved from (10025, 1345), the shaft ox's head, to its own head behind and east of it (u 10033-10094, v 1297-1366, muzzle 10075-10090, 1360).

entities.name: lead ox on long traces
entities.what: Big light-brown ox walking east at the head of the team of S5.veh.covered_ox_cart_9800, on long rope traces that run back from its rump to the oxen behind; tail swishing, a strap with a ring round its body, head raised.
entities.vis: part: forelegs hidden behind the big tiled roof of the south-side building
entities.note: Draws S5.veh.covered_ox_cart_9800 (lead animal on traces). Its fore is est past u 10200, but it belongs to this team, so t1 records it. Hind hooves (10147, 1460) planted, (10165, 1435) lifted; rump and tail u 10100-10123; body to the head at u 10227-10293, v 1287-1317 (about 190 px rump to muzzle). A rope runs from its rump at v ~1380 west to the far ox; another along its back at v ~1305 to the leader.

entities.name: driver sitting on the front of the cart
entities.what: Driver of S5.veh.covered_ox_cart_9800 sitting on the front of the shafts with his back to us, dark hair and light jacket, holding a long goad or pole across his body, facing east toward the oxen.
entities.vis: full
entities.note: Drives S5.veh.covered_ox_cart_9800. Seat = the shafts / front block at v ~1300; his feet rest on the shaft at (9822, 1292). foot = est ground straight under the seat (the cart's centre line, ~50 px north of the near wheel contact). The pole runs (9765, 1207) -> (9900, 1222).

entities.name: driver walking beside the shaft ox
entities.what: Man in a long light robe and dark cap walking east on the near side of the shaft ox, beside its shoulder, head tilted up.
entities.vis: full
entities.note: Drives S5.veh.covered_ox_cart_9800. Feet (9877, 1470) and (9928, 1480).

entities.name: leader holding the oxen's nose ropes
entities.what: Man with a light head-cloth leaning forward over the heads of the two rear oxen from their far side, holding their nose ropes and the trace to the lead ox, face turned east.
entities.vis: part: body below the chest hidden by the far ox
entities.note: Leads the team of S5.veh.covered_ox_cart_9800. Foot est north of the far ox's forelegs.

entities.name: man striding west with a stick
entities.what: Man in a light short jacket with a dark wrap at the waist, striding west with both arms flung out; a long stick in his hand slants down to the oxen's ropes.
entities.vis: full
entities.note: Feet: front (10100, 1265), back (10197, 1267). Stick (10120, 1210) -> (10090, 1267). May be another drover of this team or a passer-by gesturing at the stall crowd; grouped with the team because of the stick.

entities.name: walker behind the willow whips
entities.what: Man in a long light robe walking west, its tail flaring behind him; his upper body and head are hidden by the willow whips.
entities.vis: part: upper body and head hidden by S5.tree.willow_clump_9392
entities.note: One of the figures S5's agents saw at u 9650-9700. Feet (9682, 1625) forward and (9742, 1622) behind. Head est from the robe top at v ~1460.

entities.name: man with folded hands at the bottom edge
entities.what: Man with dark hair and a dark jacket, hands folded in his sleeves, facing east at the bottom edge of the silk, probably seated on a stool.
entities.vis: part: legs cut by the silk's bottom edge
entities.note: One of the figures S5's agents saw at u 9650-9700. A line at v ~1735 and vertical strokes below it (u 9655-9705) read as a stool seat and legs, or as his own legs; the restyle paints him standing.

entities.name: stout man with a staff
entities.what: Stout man in a long light robe and topknot cap holding a tall staff upright, facing east toward the young man.
entities.vis: full

entities.name: small child between the two men
entities.what: Small child in a reddish-brown robe standing between the man with the staff and the young man.
entities.vis: faded
entities.note: Child: ~85 px tall against ~195 px for the man with the staff (about 0.45 of an adult). Faint reddish strokes; the restyle also paints a child here.

entities.name: young man in a dark robe
entities.what: Young man in a long dark-brown robe facing west toward the man with the staff, his right hand held out to him or to the child.
entities.vis: part: feet at the silk's bottom edge

entities.name: man behind the big roof
entities.what: Man in a light robe and dark cap standing north of the big tiled roof of the south-side building; the roof's slope hides him below the waist.
entities.vis: part: lower body hidden by the south-side building's roof
entities.note: Visible to v ~1580. Foot from a standing height of ~170 px.

entities.name: small far figure under the trees
entities.what: Tiny dark figure on the far ground north of the gnarled tree, possibly a porter with something on a pole.
entities.vis: faded
entities.note: AMBIGUOUS: two dark diverging strokes (u 9550-9575, v 365-410) with a dark knot at (9578, 380); read as a small figure (~45 px, like S5's far figures) or as a broken stump/knots of the grove. The restyle paints a porter here, which is why the figure reading is kept, at low confidence.

entities.name: statue in the temple gate's west bay
entities.what: Seated guardian figure (a temple-gate statue) seen behind the lattice railing of the west side bay of the temple's shut gate.
entities.vis: part: below the shoulders hidden by the lattice
entities.src: 名画记: 清净的寺庙 (pin 30)
entities.note: Head and shoulders at u 9930-9955, v 102-135 behind the lattice (u 9910-9970, v 125-160). Read as a statue (temple gates house guardian figures in the side bays); it could be a person looking out.

entities.name: statue in the temple gate's east bay
entities.what: Second guardian figure (statue) behind the lattice railing of the east side bay of the temple's shut gate.
entities.vis: part: below the shoulders hidden by the lattice
entities.src: 名画记: 清净的寺庙 (pin 30)

entities.name: westernmost pig of the herd
entities.what: Dark grey, bristly-backed pig with its head down, rooting; the westernmost of a herd of four pigs on the open ground north of the road (the other three are t2's), facing east.
entities.vis: part: legs lost in the tree's twigs
entities.note: Body u 10127-10210, v 400-453; legs lost in the tree's twigs, so fore and hind are est at the herd's ground line. Group S4.grp.pig_herd_10236 is t2's (it lists the other three pigs).

entities.name: gnarled tree in the far grove
entities.what: Old tree with a thick, twisting, knotty trunk (pale bark, dark knots) rising from spreading roots and leaning east into heavy limbs at about v 270; crown of fan-shaped clusters of fine needle-like strokes (pine-like) reaching up to the houses.
entities.vis: full
entities.note: Roots u 9417-9467, v 417-442; knotty fork (9500-9525, 258-283). Its crown merges with S5.tree.pine_9285 to the west (crown_w est where they meet).

entities.name: slender leaning tree
entities.what: Slender tree: a thin trunk leaning up to the north-west from a small forked foot on the open ground to a dark knotty head, from which sprays of needle-like strokes spread.
entities.vis: part: crown mixed with the grove
entities.note: AMBIGUOUS: knotty head at (9670-9715, 300-335); a thin stroke runs from it down-right to a short fork at (9776, 556) on blank ground. Read as the leaning trunk and its foot; it could instead be a drooping limb of a tree whose trunk is hidden (then the base would be under the head, about (9700, 470)). The restyle merges it into S4.tree.big_9840.

entities.name: tall tree between the two parasols
entities.what: Tall tree whose dark knotty trunk rises from behind the stalls between the dark and the light parasol, forks at about two-thirds height, and climbs north-east with a crown of fan-shaped needle-like sprays (pine-like) spreading from the grove to over the pigs and up to below the temple.
entities.vis: part: trunk foot hidden by the parasols and the stall
entities.note: Trunk visible u 9830-9860 from v ~900 up to the fork (9865, 715); main limb (9940, 560) -> (10000, 300). Base est at the light-parasol table's foot line.

entities.name: pollarded tree over the mat awning
entities.what: Old pollarded tree (willow-like): a dark, swollen, knobbly head from which long straight limbs with fan-shaped needle-like sprays spread far west over the mat awning and up the silk; its trunk is hidden behind the dark parasol and the stall.
entities.vis: part: trunk hidden
entities.note: The tree whose trunk is near u 9600 (brief). Head u 9583-9703, v 820-887. Its westward limbs reach u ~9160 (over S5's seam); no other trunk under that crown was found.

entities.name: round things hanging under the light parasol
entities.what: Two or three small round things with dark spots (gourds, small baskets or lanterns) hanging together from the stall frame under the west edge of the light parasol, above the small table.
entities.vis: full
entities.note: At u 9875-9908, v 892-915 (about 30 px across). base = est ground straight below them. Could also be read as a small face peering out; the restyle paints dark round wares here.

entities.name: the mat-awning stall
entities.what: A stall under a woven-mat awning and a big dark parasol behind (north of) the big covered cart: two men tend wares on the counter and reach for a stack of round goods.

entities.name: the parasol-and-basket stall
entities.what: A stall under a second mat awning and a big light parasol, with a small table and a huge basket of heaped brown goods; men lean over and bend toward the basket, one raises his arm, a man in a dark robe and a child look on, and a man crouches by a bench at the back.

entities.name: the big covered cart's team
entities.what: The three oxen and the drovers of S5.veh.covered_ox_cart_9800 heading east: the shaft ox and a far-side ox side by side, a lead ox on long traces; one driver sits on the shafts with a goad, one walks beside the shaft ox, one leans over the oxen's heads holding the nose ropes, and a man strides past with a stick.
entities.src: 名画记: 牛拉大盖车 (pin 31)
entities.note: The cart itself is S5.veh.covered_ox_cart_9800 (S5 builds it and its harness).

entities.name: talkers at the bottom edge
entities.what: A stout man with a staff and a young man in a dark robe face each other and talk at the bottom of the silk, a small child between them.
